causes.reasoning: Route CPU spiked 2 to 48 and memory doubled 248M to 489M with latency 10x and restart/agent logs, and both failing travel services call route heavily, making route the common upstream failure point.
Travel shows new Service Unavailable errors 0 to 0.08 in 20-100s window while calling route/train/ticketinfo/seat, acting as direct victim propagating 500s to its callers.
Travel2 also calls route/ticketinfo/train/seat and shows new Service Unavailable log errors with error spike at 60-80s, same downstream failure as travel.
Admin-travel calls travel and travel2 and shows new Internal Server Error 0 to 0.06 matching travel failure window, clearly a caller victim.
Food calls travel-service and shows new Internal Server Error 0 to 0.016 in same 20-100s window, a downstream caller victim of travel failure.
